actual_file_scope: Entire candidate, all ten displays and scope remark freshly read. No correction.
checks: For odd m|q+1 the norm-one primitive root zeta gives actual SU_m(q) shift and clock matrices: X permutes an orthonormal basis, Y has diagonal norm one, detX=(-1)^(m-1)=1, detY=zeta^(m(m-1)/2)=1.

Direct basis calculation gives XY=zeta^(-1)YX. Its scalar lies in the SU scalar kernel, and X^aY^b scalar forces a=0 from permutation of coordinate lines and then b=0 from the diagonal entries. Thus the projective (Z/m)^2 embedding is exact.
The set-theoretic lift X^aY^b gives c((a,b),(a_prime,b_prime))=zeta^(b a_prime), with no additional reduction factors since X^m=Y^m=1. This cocycle is killed pointwise by m.

For trivial coefficients on an abelian group every multiplicative coboundary is symmetric. The alternating ratio on the two standard generators is zeta^(-1); hence a power c^e can be a coboundary only if m divides e. This proves exact order inside H2((Z/m)^2,K^times), without assuming injection from smaller coefficients.
Trivial field projection makes restriction of the full semilinear extension exactly the same scalar extension.

For p=2, m=2^f+1 is odd and unbounded. For odd p and positive even f, p^f=1 mod8 and m=(p^f+1)/2 is odd and unbounded. Every m is prime to p and values m>=5 lie in the previously checked simple unitary range.

The construction refutes only a uniform exponent deduced from a Hermitian model. It asserts no realization on a fixed geometric group, no unbounded geometric Brauer period on one fixed surface, and no failure of the desired count.
